scripts.text:
[Swordman]
It...
Can't be...
You've been reborn, haven't you?
scripts.translation:
[劍士]
這...不可能...
你轉生了，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Swordman]
I see you're retreading the path of the Swordman! Once you've gotten used to brandishing a sword, you can never go back!!
scripts.translation:
[劍士]
看來你又踏上劍士之路了！
一旦習慣了揮劍的感覺，就再也回不去了！！

scripts.text:
[Swordman]
Hmm? Ah, you must first master the Basic Skills before you are ready to become a Swordman.
scripts.translation:
[劍士]
嗯？
啊，你得先掌握基本技能，才能成為劍士。

scripts.text:
[Swordman]
Come back to me when you have finished learning the Basic Novice Skills.
scripts.translation:
[劍士]
等你學完初心者基本技能後再來找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Swordman]
Excellent! Let me promote you to a Swordman right away!
scripts.translation:
[劍士]
很好！
現在就為你轉職成劍士！

scripts.text:
[Swordman]
Hmm... You look like a well-experienced Swordman. Still, I'm sure that you must train to improve your skills and gain strength!
scripts.translation:
[劍士]
嗯...你看起來已經是個經驗豐富的劍士了。
不過，仍然要勤加訓練，磨練技藝，增強實力！

scripts.text:
[Swordman]
Hm...?
You're a reborn
warrior, aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[劍士]
嗯...？
你是轉生後的戰士，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Swordman]
Hmmm...
It seems that being
a Swordman is not part
of your destiny. I'm sorry,
but it seems there is nothing
I can do for you.
scripts.translation:
[劍士]
嗯...
看來，劍士並非命運為你安排的道路。
抱歉，我恐怕幫不上什麼忙。

scripts.text:
[Swordman]
Welcome to the
Swordman Association!
scripts.translation:
[劍士]
歡迎來到劍士協會！

scripts.text:
[Swordman]
So...
What business
brings you to us?
scripts.translation:
[劍士]
那麼...
你來找我們有什麼事？

scripts.text: Job Change
scripts.translation: 轉職

scripts.text: About Swordman.
scripts.translation: 關於劍士

scripts.text: About the Job requirements.
scripts.translation: 轉職條件

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Swordman]
Job change? Muhahaha! But you're already a Swordman! Be proud and be strong!
scripts.translation:
[劍士]
轉職？
Muhahaha!
可你已經是劍士了！
拿出劍士的驕傲，變得更強吧！

scripts.text:
[Swordman]
Haha! Oh boy. I'm flattered, but you already have another job! Still, I can't blame you...
scripts.translation:
[劍士]
哈哈！
哎呀，你這麼嚮往劍士，真讓我受寵若驚，可你已經有其他職業了！
不過，也不能怪你...

scripts.text:
[Swordman]
So you wish to become a proud Swordman? By all means, please sign up!
scripts.translation:
[劍士]
想成為一名值得驕傲的劍士？
那就來報名吧！

scripts.text: Sign up.
scripts.translation: 報名

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Swordman]
Ah, yes. Your application will be reviewed as soon as possible.
scripts.translation:
[劍士]
好，我們會盡快稽核你的申請。

scripts.text:
[Swordman]
If you have already met the requirements, you can take an interview right now. Would you like to?
scripts.translation:
[劍士]
如果已經滿足條件，現在就能參加面試。
要參加嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Swordman]
Good, good.
Now, let's see...
scripts.translation:
[劍士]
很好，很好。
那麼，讓我們看看...

scripts.text:
[Swordman]
Alright then. Feel free to come back whenever you are ready. All you have to do now is meet our requirements. Good luck to you.
scripts.translation:
[劍士]
好，準備好了隨時回來。
現在你只需要先達到我們的要求。
祝你好運。

scripts.text:
[Swordman]
Hm? Alright, come back whenever you change your mind. The world can always use another Swordman!
scripts.translation:
[劍士]
嗯？好的，改變主意後隨時回來。世界永遠需要更多的劍士！

scripts.text:
[Swordman]
Hm, you still haven't learned all of the Basic Skills. You need to do that before you can become a Swordman.
scripts.translation:
[劍士]
嗯，你還沒學會所有基本技能。
想成為劍士，得先把它們學完。

scripts.text:
[Swordman]
Hm, you've learned all of the Basic Skills but didn't take the test yet. You must first pass the exam before you can change your job to Swordman.
scripts.translation:
[劍士]
嗯，你已經學會所有基本技能，不過還沒參加考試。
通過考試後，才能轉職為劍士。

scripts.text:
[Swordman]
Hahaha! Congratulations! Now you are fully qualified to be a real Swordman! I will transform you right away!
scripts.translation:
[劍士]
哈哈哈！
恭喜！
現在你完全有資格成為真正的劍士了！
我馬上為你辦理轉職！

scripts.text:
[Swordman]
[Swordman]
So you wish to know more about the mighty Swordman job? Well, then...
scripts.translation:
[劍士]
[劍士]
想進一步瞭解強大的劍士職業？
好，那就...

scripts.text:
[Swordman]
Check the requirements for job change again, and come back when you are ready.
scripts.translation:
[劍士]
再次確認轉職要求，準備好後再回來。

scripts.text:
[Swordman]
Enter the room to my right so that you can take the test. You'll need to speak to my right so you can enter the examination area.
scripts.translation:
[劍士]
去我右邊的房間參加考試吧。
先找右邊的人談談，才能進入考場。

scripts.text:
[Swordman]
Once again, congratulations. I expect that you will be a good representative of the Swordman Association.
scripts.translation:
[劍士]
再次恭喜你。
希望你能成為劍士協會的優秀代表。

scripts.text:
[Swordman]
So you wish to know more about the mighty Swordman job? Well, then...
scripts.translation:
[劍士]
想進一步瞭解強大的劍士職業？
好，那就...

scripts.text:
[Swordman]
Amongst the First Class jobs, the Swordman is the best melee fighter for three reasons.
There are 3 reasons why Swordy is the best to approch a fight!
scripts.translation:
[劍士]
在一轉職業中，劍士是最出色的近戰戰士，原因有三個。
劍士最適合衝上前去戰鬥，原因有三個！

scripts.text:
[Swordman]
First, Swordman has the benefit of additional HP. Second, Swordman generally have access to a wider selection fo weapons than the other First Class jobs.
scripts.translation:
[劍士]
第一，劍士擁有更高的HP。
第二，比起其他一轉職業，劍士能使用的武器種類更多。

scripts.text:
[Swordman]
And third, most of the Swordman skills are crushing physical attacks! In my opinion, being a Swordman is the best job ever!
scripts.translation:
[劍士]
第三，劍士的大部分技能都是威力強大的物理攻擊！
在我看來，劍士就是最棒的職業！

scripts.text:
[Swordman]
Hmmm...
But there's no need to tell you the requirements. You've met them and already became a Swordman! Well, anyway...
scripts.translation:
[劍士]
嗯...
不過，沒必要跟你說轉職條件了吧。
你早已滿足條件，成為劍士了！
總之...

scripts.text:
[Swordman]
Hmmm...
It's too late for you to become a Swordman. You already have another job. Still, there's no harm in telling you...
scripts.translation:
[劍士]
嗯...
你已經有其他職業，不能再成為劍士了。
不過，告訴你也無妨...

scripts.text:
[Swordman]
Hmmm...

[Swordman]
First, you must learn all 9 of the Basic Skills. If you can't complete this requirement, you won't be able to change to any job.
scripts.translation:
[劍士]
首先，必須學會全部9個基本技能。
達不到這一要求，就無法轉職成任何職業。

scripts.text:
[Swordman]
Second, you must pass the Swordman Test. Inquire the Test Manager located in the waiting room of the Swordman Test.
scripts.translation:
[劍士]
其次，必須通過劍士考試。
詳情請諮詢劍士考試等候室裡的考試管理員。

scripts.text:
[Swordman]
If you can complete these 2 requirements, you can change to a Swordman anytime you want.
scripts.translation:
[劍士]
滿足這兩個條件後，就可以隨時轉職為劍士。

scripts.text:
[Swordman]
Ha ha ha!
Ah, youth!
scripts.translation:
[劍士]
哈哈！
啊，青春！

scripts.text:
[Swordman]
Sorry guy, but I can only allow Novices to enter the Test Hall.
scripts.translation:
[劍士]
抱歉，夥計，只有初心者能進入考場。

scripts.text:
[Swordman]
Who the hell are you?! Nobody, other than Novices, is permitted to come in here!
scripts.translation:
[劍士]
你他媽是誰？！除了初心者，誰都不許進這裡！

scripts.text:
[Swordman]
Stop! I can't let you in until you learn all of the Basic Skills. The Test Hall isn't for goofing off!
scripts.translation:
[劍士]
站住！
沒學會所有基本技能，我就不能放你進去。
考場可不是胡鬧的地方！

scripts.text:
[Swordman]
Hey. You need to talk to the Swordman in the center of the room, not me.
scripts.translation:
[劍士]
嘿，你該找房間中央的劍士，不是我。

scripts.text:
[Swordman]
Stop! If you want to take the Swordman Test, you'll need to fill out an application first.
scripts.translation:
[劍士]
站住！
想參加劍士考試，得先填好申請表。

scripts.text: [Swordman]
scripts.translation: [劍士]

scripts.text:
[Swordman]
The Swordman in the center of the room can help you with that, got it?
scripts.translation:
[劍士]
房間中央的劍士可以幫你處理這件事，明白了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Swordman]
I will tell you about the Test! Listen carefully, I won't repeat myself.
scripts.translation:
[劍士]
我來說明考試規則！
仔細聽，我只說一遍。

scripts.text:
[Swordman]
The purpose of this test is to confirm whether or not you are qualified to be a Swordman. As you know, a Swordman needs physical strength and spirit!
scripts.translation:
[劍士]
這場考試是為了確認你是否有資格成為劍士。
你也知道，劍士需要強健的體魄和堅強的意志！

scripts.text:
[Swordman]
Without those, you won't be able to become a Swordman. Now, the conditions for completing this test are very simple.
scripts.translation:
[劍士]
缺少這兩樣，就當不了劍士。
通過考試的條件很簡單。

scripts.text:
[Swordman]
You will travel through three courses and must reach the final checkpoint within ^FF000010 minutes^000000.
scripts.translation:
[劍士]
你需要通過三個關卡，在^FF000010分鐘^000000內到達最後一個檢查點。

scripts.text:
[Swordman]
If you choose to 'Surrender,' or if you run out of time, you will not pass the test.
scripts.translation:
[劍士]
選擇“放棄”，或是超時，都算考試失敗。

scripts.text:
[Swordman]
If you find that you are not strong enough to pass the test, head to the entrance of the course and talk to the checkpoint manager.
scripts.translation:
[劍士]
如果覺得自己實力不足，無法通過考試，就到關卡入口找檢查點管理員。

scripts.text:
[Swordman]
As you travel through the three courses, you may fall to a random, underground area. The course is designed so that you can still find your way back.
scripts.translation:
[劍士]
通過這三個關卡時，你可能會掉進隨機的地下區域。
不過，那裡也設計了通道，讓你能找到回去的路。

scripts.text:
[Swordman]
However, be careful, as this will waste your time! Godspeed to you.
scripts.translation:
[劍士]
但這樣會耽誤時間，所以一定要小心！
祝你順利。

scripts.text:
[Test Hall Staff]
Hm? How did you get inside? You're not supposed to be in here, so please leave now.
scripts.translation:
[考場工作人員]
嗯？
你怎麼進來的？
你不該在這裡，請馬上離開。

scripts.text:
[Test Hall Staff]
Who are you?! This place is for the Swordman Test! You're not allowed to be in here! Leave now!
scripts.translation:
[考場工作人員]
你是誰？！
這裡是劍士考場，你不能進來！
馬上離開！

scripts.text:
[Test Hall Staff]
So are you the one who wants to be a Swordman? Alright! You look reliable!
scripts.translation:
[考場工作人員]
你就是想成為劍士的人？
好！
看起來挺可靠嘛！

scripts.text:
[Test Hall Staff]
Retesting? Try not to worry about it. It's good that you don't back down from a challenge! Here, take these and cheer up!
scripts.translation:
[考場工作人員]
來重考？
別太擔心，面對挑戰不退縮，是好事！
來，拿著這些，打起精神！

scripts.text:
[Test Hall Staff]
Don't ever give up! Now retesting!
scripts.translation:
[考場工作人員]
別放棄！
現在開始重考！

scripts.text: [Test Hall Staff]
scripts.translation: [考場工作人員]

scripts.text:
[Test Hall Staff]
Try to relax and do your best. This course isn't so difficult.
scripts.translation:
[考場工作人員]
放輕鬆，盡力就好。
這些關卡沒有那麼難。

scripts.text:
[Mae]
I sencerely congratulate you for passing the test!
I already sent your test result to the Job Department. Please inquire at the Officer in Centre.Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[梅]
衷心祝賀你通過考試！
我已經把考試結果送到轉職部門了，請去找中央的負責人。
謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Medic]
This is the {0} check point! Cheer up!
scripts.translation:
[醫務兵]
這是第{0}個檢查點！加油！

scripts.text:
[Test Hall Staff]
Do you surrender?
scripts.translation:
[考場工作人員]
你要放棄嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Test Hall Staff]
Bravo! Go for it again!
scripts.translation:
[考場工作人員]
幹得漂亮！再來一次！

scripts.text:
[Test Hall Staff]
Applicant {0}. Do you surrender??
scripts.translation:
[考場工作人員]
考生{0}，你要放棄嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 否
